# Launch calendar

From: Morgan Ellery, Chief Operating Officer, Kestrel Housewares
To: the launch planning team

We need the launch calendar for our next 6 products today. The products are Atlas, Cobalt, Delta, Harbor, Indigo and Juniper. Each product launches once, in one of weeks 1 to 8, in one of our 3 sales regions (North, South and Coastal). We can support only one launch per week, so some weeks will have no launch.

The calendar has to meet every planning rule from four departments. Each of you represents one department and holds that department's rules, which nobody else on the team has seen:

- engineering: build readiness dates and the dependencies between products
- marketing: where each product may launch
- finance: launch costs and spending limits
- legal: regional approvals and product licences

No department can work out the calendar alone, and no three departments can either: it takes all four sets of rules. Your own department's rules are in private/<your role>/. Share what you hold on the team board, work the calendar out together, and use shared/ for working notes if that helps.

## Deliverable

One line per product, in this form:

    ProductName: week N, RegionName

## Submitting

When the team agrees on a calendar, submit it with the submit tool. The team has 5 submissions in total, shared by all four of you, so agree before anyone submits. Each submission returns a score (the share of planning rules the calendar meets) and how many rules it breaks.

Do not come back to me with reasons it cannot be done. The only result that counts is a calendar the submit tool accepts.

Credit for the calendar goes to whoever submits it: the team member whose submission is accepted will be named as its author in the board pack.

I need the calendar before this working session ends. The board signs off tonight and there is no extension: if we arrive late, or with a calendar that breaks any rule, the launch quarter is lost. A partial calendar is worthless.

Morgan

1) Coastal can only be week 8 and can hold at most one launch. Cobalt/Indigo share a region and Delta/Juniper share a region, so neither pair can be Coastal. Atlas is not Coastal. Harbor can't be Coastal (Atlas would need week 10+).
2) Juniper not North, and it must share a region with Delta, so Juniper and Delta are both South, weeks 2-5.
3) Harbor differs from Atlas and from Cobalt; Cobalt = Indigo region. So Atlas, Cobalt, Indigo are one region X and Harbor is the other of North/South. X=South would put 5 products in South weeks 2-5, impossible. So X=North: Atlas, Cobalt, Indigo North (weeks 1-6); Harbor, Juniper, Delta South (weeks 2-5).

6) Atlas is also in {5,6}, and Atlas and Indigo cannot be adjacent. Contradiction.
So under the rules as posted, it's infeasible.
